basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old avid gamer from Toronto, Canada. By day I work as a software analyst, but by night, I'm diving into various gaming worlds, especially on my console. Outside of gaming, I'm a big fan of indie music, particularly Arctic Monkeys, and enjoy building custom Magic: The Gathering cubes for casual play with friends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings exploring new gaming strategies or catching live music events when possible. My typical online hours are from 7 PM to midnight EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in gaming strategies, developed through years of gaming across various platforms. My analytical skills from my job as a software analyst also help me dissect and understand game mechanics. Additionally, I have a growing knowledge of card games, self-taught through online resources and community interactions.
